indicator_name: Gross inflow of foreign direct investment into Kazakhstan from foreign direct investors, by resident's economic activity
description: Валовой приток прямых иностранных инвестиций в Казахстан от иностранных прямых инвесторов, по видам экономической деятельности резидентов
unit: million USD, flow over the quarter
methodology: NBK formId=286, one row per activity (sections; mining, manufacturing, finance, ICT, professional and transport split into sub-industries; sub_industry_2 is not kept). Items: ОКЭД section letters (PQR = education, health and arts pooled by the NBK; NEC = not determined), <section>.<sub-industry> for the split ones, TOTAL = all rows. Dated by the quarter covered: the NBK stamps a quarter with the day after it (as FDI_NET_INFLOW), shifted here. TOTAL equals the sum over countries of FDI_GROSS_INFLOW_BY_COUNTRY in all 86 quarters 2005 Q1 - 2026 Q2 (checked 2026-11-07). Gross inflow from foreign direct investors, not the net BOP figure: FDI_NET_INFLOW nets out repayments and withdrawals.
